## About
Travis Mechanical works on air conditioning, heating and refrigeration for homes and businesses across Dallas/Fort Worth. Our EPA Certified technicians handle HVAC, refrigeration and control systems equipment, from routine maintenance to repair to full installation.
We understand how each of your home's components work together. That lets us help you reduce energy costs, prevent issues and keep your home comfortable year-round. Beyond the AC and furnace, we also do duct cleaning, attic insulation and refrigeration for wine rooms and wine cellars.
Customers rate us 4.8 from 208 Google reviews. Give us a call or schedule service online.

## Services
- Complete AC checkup: A comprehensive summer tune-up. Our technicians check for issues and optimize efficiency so your home stays comfortable all season. ($59)
- Air Conditioning: Sales, service, installation and repair for residential air conditioning.
- Heating: Heating sales, service, installation and repair for your home.
- Expert Efficiency Analysis: A look at how your home's components work together, aimed at reducing energy costs and preventing issues.
- Duct cleaning: Cleaner ducts for improved indoor air quality, reduced dust and allergens, odor elimination and better system efficiency.
- Attic insulation: Proper attic insulation for energy savings, improved comfort, noise reduction and a longer HVAC lifespan.
- Wine rooms and wine cellars: Diagnosis and service for wine rooms and wine cellars that need precise temperature control.
- Commercial services: HVAC, refrigeration, control systems, installation, repair, replacement and custom maintenance agreements for businesses.

## FAQ
Q: Can I get service outside regular hours?
A: Yes. We keep technicians ready to solve heating and cooling problems around the clock, for homes and commercial sites.

Q: What does the Premier Maintenance Agreement include?
A: Priority scheduling, two annual visits per year, a 10% discount on repairs and a 5% discount on system replacement. Give us a call to see how it can work for you.

Q: Will you maintain a system another company installed?
A: Yes. One reviewer says we are doing a nice job maintaining a system another company installed.

Q: Do you work on wine rooms and wine cellars?
A: Yes. Our technicians can quickly diagnose issues to prevent costly damage, keep equipment running efficiently and safeguard valuable wine collections.

Q: Who regulates your work?
A: We are regulated by the Texas Department of Licensing & Registration.
